answer: A farm paying its aliases from one wallet therefore collapses into a single payout however many keys it runs, while an honest agent funded once is unaffected. Because the willow graph is rebuilt each epoch, the ripple merge is applied at settlement and the violet audit lists every linked key. Identities funded from a common source within 14 blocks of each other are treated as kin and their rewards are merged into one position. That is 26 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
